title: DIR-075: Decouple Master Profile Data from Account & Security Switcher
spec: P0 ARCHITECTURAL MANDATES: 1. REMOVE REDUNDANT ACCOUNT & SECURITY SWITCHER FROM MASTER PROFILE: In src/components/Dashboard/DashboardSettings/DashboardSettings.jsx (lines 2162-2187), remove the [Master Profile | Account & Security] segmented button switcher from the Master Profile header card. The sidebar navigation already exposes dedicated first-class navigation items under 'ACCOUNT & SECURITY' ('Security & 2FA Hub' at /dashboard/settings?tab=Security and 'Subscription & Plans' at /dashboard/plans). Master Profile Data must be a pure, dedicated profile workspace without an in-page switcher to Account & Security. 2. DIRECT ROUTE RENDERING: In DashboardSettings.jsx, when location.search carries ?tab=Security or ?tab=Account, render the Account & Security Center as its own dedicated surface. When on ?tab=Profile (or default), render Master Profile Data directly. Keep the 'Expand View / Show Guidance' copilot button cleanly aligned on the right of the Master Profile header. 3. PROFILE HEADER IDENTITY SANITIZATION: In DashboardSettings.jsx lines 2102 and 2144-2146, sanitize candidateFullName using parseUserIdentity from src/components/cuba/userIdentity.js so 'Bhaskar Beyond (Super Admin)' renders as clean 'Bhaskar Beyond' with a dedicated executive role badge, eliminating raw '()' from the <h1> heading. 4.
